messages:
Iona Martin: Hey folks! Iona here — joining as Product Engineer (remote, Halifax) starting Monday. Excited to meet y'all. Quick q: does the SF office get good afternoon light for plants? Also heard about a Friday lunch tradition — ramen run? Also... I have a sourdough starter I'm happy to share 🍞
Maya Chen: Welcome Iona! :wave: SF office has big east windows on 4th floor, afternoon light is great. Friday lunch usually a rotating pick — ramen, tacos, sometimes a pizza order. Ramen run is alive :ramen:
Liam Chen: welcome!! Succulents and snake plants are low-effort for windowsill. If you want a desk plant, ping @ops for the desk-voucher. Also +1 to sourdough swap :bread:
Priya Singh: Sourdough starter swap? count me in. can bring jars. :yum:
Zara Gomez: there's also #plants Slack — people post cuttings and care tips. FYI we have a 'no-peat' potting mix in the office closet if you want eco-friendly soil :) 
hr-bot: Welcome Iona! Please complete the new-hire equipment & access form: https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/forms/equipment
Maya Chen: Also ping me if you want a walking buddy — there is a 12:30 loop around the park.
Iona Martin: Thanks all! Love the plant tips and the walking invite. I'll bring a small jar of starter next week :) Where's a good place to leave it when I come into the office? 
Liam Chen: Leave it on the kitchen counter labeled with your name, someone will put it in the mini-fridge if it's warm out. We usually tape a note.
Priya Singh: Also food club meetup every Thursday at 4pm — good place to meet people before Friday 🍽️
Iona Martin: Perfect, thanks! Looking forward to meeting everyone — and maybe swapping recipes. :)
